description: The shared vocabulary every biosignal event class inherits. Each category carries a scope: acquisition for what was done, given and observed during a recording, finding for what a reader concluded from the signal. Every category is acquisition-scoped so far; a finding every modality recognises would join under its own scope, and a modality's own findings belong to its own set. State-like terms follow the instant-or-span convention: an event with duration 0 marks entry into the state, which holds until the next event of the same family; an event with a duration bounds the state to that span.

TECHNICAL.description: Events of the recording apparatus and its operation.

CALIBRATION.name: Calibration
CALIBRATION.description: Calibration signal or procedure. A span covers it; an instant marks its start.

ELECTRODE_FAULT.name: Electrode fault
ELECTRODE_FAULT.description: A loose, dried, bridged or detached electrode, whose artifact can pass for cerebral activity. A span covers the fault; an instant marks its start. The viewer also binds the event to the channel concerned through its channel list.

meta.electrode: The electrode concerned, by its canonical label.

ELECTRODE_FIX.name: Electrode fixed
ELECTRODE_FIX.description: An electrode re-attached, re-gelled or replaced. A span covers the handling (rubbing or pressing); an instant marks the moment it was done. The fault it ends is its own event.

meta.electrode: The electrode concerned, by its canonical label.

FAULT.name: Technical fault
FAULT.description: A fault in the apparatus other than an electrode. A span covers it; an instant marks its start.

meta.component: The part affected: amplifier, cable or software.

IMPEDANCE.name: Impedance check
IMPEDANCE.description: Electrode impedance check. A span covers it; an instant marks its start.

meta.readings: Impedance readings keyed by channel label, in kilo-ohms.

MONTAGE_CHANGE.name: Montage or reference change
MONTAGE_CHANGE.description: State-like: the recording montage or reference changed here and holds until the next change.

meta.montage: Name of the montage or reference in use from this point.

PAUSE.name: Recording paused
PAUSE.description: A span covers the pause; an instant marks its start.

TRIGGER.name: Trigger
TRIGGER.description: A reference marker for measuring an effect, such as a stimulus onset.

INTERVENTION.description: Things done to the patient during the recording. Procedures are enumerated only where knowing which one changes the reading; everything else is the generic procedure with the specifics in its metadata.

CARE.name: Care and handling
CARE.description: Nursing care or examination: turning, suction, washing, a physical examination. A span covers it; an instant marks its start.

PATIENT_BUTTON.name: Patient event button
PATIENT_BUTTON.description: The patient pressed the event marker.

PROCEDURE.name: Procedure
PROCEDURE.description: A procedure none of the enumerated terms covers. A span covers it; an instant marks its start.

OPERATION.name: Operative procedure
OPERATION.description: A span covers the operation; an instant marks a stage of it.

meta.stage: The stage marked: incision, clamp, reperfusion, closure.

OBSERVATION.description: What was observed of the patient at the bedside: behaviour, body position and level of consciousness. Body position and level of consciousness are state-like; the level of consciousness is the behavioural state on the AVPU scale, distinct from any sleep stage read from the signal. The patient's cardiorespiratory and autonomic state is PHYSIOLOGY, whichever way it was noticed.

POSITION_UPRIGHT.name: Upright
POSITION_UPRIGHT.description: State-like body position: sitting or standing.

POSITION_HEAD_DOWN.name: Head down
POSITION_HEAD_DOWN.description: State-like body position: the Trendelenburg position.

LOC_ALERT.name: Alert
LOC_ALERT.description: State-like level of consciousness: awake and responsive.

meta.gcs: Glasgow Coma Scale total, if scored.
meta.rass: Richmond Agitation-Sedation Scale score, if scored.

LOC_VOICE.name: Responds to voice
LOC_VOICE.description: State-like level of consciousness: responds to voice, no closer qualification.

meta.gcs: Glasgow Coma Scale total, if scored.
meta.rass: Richmond Agitation-Sedation Scale score, if scored.

LOC_CONFUSED.name: Confused
LOC_CONFUSED.description: State-like level of consciousness: responds to voice, disoriented.

meta.gcs: Glasgow Coma Scale total, if scored.
meta.rass: Richmond Agitation-Sedation Scale score, if scored.

LOC_SOMNOLENT.name: Somnolent
LOC_SOMNOLENT.description: State-like level of consciousness: responds to voice, drifts back.

meta.gcs: Glasgow Coma Scale total, if scored.
meta.rass: Richmond Agitation-Sedation Scale score, if scored.

LOC_ASLEEP.name: Asleep
LOC_ASLEEP.description: State-like level of consciousness: the behavioural observation of sleep, not a sleep stage read from the signal.

meta.gcs: Glasgow Coma Scale total, if scored.
meta.rass: Richmond Agitation-Sedation Scale score, if scored.

meta.gcs: Glasgow Coma Scale total, if scored.
meta.rass: Richmond Agitation-Sedation Scale score, if scored.

meta.gcs: Glasgow Coma Scale total, if scored.
meta.rass: Richmond Agitation-Sedation Scale score, if scored.

ENVIRONMENT.description: External influences on the recording: things in the surroundings that reach the signal or the patient without anyone intending them to.

DISTURBANCE.name: Mechanical disturbance
DISTURBANCE.description: The bed, a cable or the equipment bumped, pulled or moved. A span covers it; an instant marks its start.

ELECTRICAL_DEVICE.name: Electrical device nearby
ELECTRICAL_DEVICE.description: A device switched on or brought near, the usual source of mains interference. State-like: an instant marks its arrival until the next event of the family; a span bounds its presence.

meta.device: The device: infusion pump, ventilator, phone, cleaning machine.

LIGHT.name: Light change
LIGHT.description: Lights switched on or off, or daylight changing. State-like: an instant marks the change until the next.

meta.change: What changed: on, off, dimmed, daylight.

NOISE.name: Noise
NOISE.description: A sound in the surroundings other than speech: an alarm, a door, construction. A span covers it; an instant marks its start.

PERSON.name: Person entering or leaving
PERSON.description: Staff or a visitor entering or leaving the room. An instant marks the entry or the exit; a span covers a stay.

VOICES.name: Voices nearby
VOICES.description: Speech in the surroundings not addressed to the patient. A span covers it; an instant marks its start. Speech addressed to the patient is verbal stimulation, and the patient speaking is an observation.

PHYSIOLOGY.description: The cardiorespiratory and autonomic state of the patient during the recording, whether seen at the bedside or read from a polygraphic channel such as ECG, respiration or pulse oximetry. A term here names a state of the body, not an interpretation of the signal of interest, which is a finding of the modality; who noticed it is the annotator. State-like terms follow the instant-or-span convention.

BRADYCARDIA.name: Bradycardia
BRADYCARDIA.description: Heart rate below the range expected for the patient's age. State-like.

meta.rate: Heart rate in beats per minute, if measured.

TACHYCARDIA.name: Tachycardia
TACHYCARDIA.description: Heart rate above the range expected for the patient's age. State-like.

meta.rate: Heart rate in beats per minute, if measured.

ARRHYTHMIA.name: Arrhythmia
ARRHYTHMIA.description: An irregular rhythm or ectopic beats. A span covers a run; an instant marks a single beat.

ASYSTOLE.name: Asystole
ASYSTOLE.description: No beat for longer than the rhythm allows, up to and including cardiac standstill. A span covers the pause.

APNEA.name: Apnoea
APNEA.description: Breathing stopped. A span covers it.

HYPOPNEA.name: Hypopnoea
HYPOPNEA.description: Breathing reduced in depth or rate. A span covers it.

HYPERVENTILATION.name: Spontaneous hyperventilation
HYPERVENTILATION.description: Breathing faster or deeper than the situation calls for, unprompted; the EEG activation set names the procedure. A span covers it.

PERIODIC_BREATHING.name: Periodic breathing
PERIODIC_BREATHING.description: Breathing waxing and waning in cycles, with or without pauses. A span covers the pattern.

DESATURATION.name: Oxygen desaturation
DESATURATION.description: Oxygen saturation below the range expected for the patient. A span covers it.

meta.nadir: Lowest saturation in percent, if measured.

SWEATING.name: Sweating
SWEATING.description: State-like: sweating began here and holds until marked otherwise.

HICCUP.name: Hiccup
HICCUP.description: A span covers a bout; an instant marks a single hiccup.
